# IMQOptions.compressAbove property

Compress a queue message with zstd when its JSON is longer than this many characters. `0`<!-- -->, the default, never does. Read from `IMQ_COMPRESS_ABOVE` when not given.

**Signature:**

```typescript
compressAbove?: number;
```

## Remarks

Unlike [IMQOptions.useGzip](/api/core/latest/core.imqoptions.usegzip/) it need not agree between producer and consumer: every queue reads plain, gzipped and zstd messages alike. Turn it on only once every consumer runs a version that reads zstd, and on Node 22.15 or later; an older Node writes plain JSON whatever it says. [IMQOptions.useGzip](/api/core/latest/core.imqoptions.usegzip/) wins where both are set. Applies to queue messages only, not to [IMessageQueue.publish()](/api/core/latest/core.imessagequeue.publish/)<!-- -->.
